desc:
She says this to [**Marisa in the Extra Stage**](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Hidden_Star_in_Four_Seasons/Story/Marisa%27s_Extra). The idea here is that Marisa called Okina a showoff for causing the incident to establish her dominance. Marisa then later wanted Okina to tell everybody that it's her who resolved the incident.

So this line here has lot of "***The pot calling the kettle black***" in sentiment.
